name: napojnice
description: Pratitelj smjena i napojnica za konobare — REST API (Express + Prisma + SQLite) + React SPA (Vite).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work --ipc=host --network host -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble npx playwright test
